Self.Wiki: This map object represents an event within the map.

PartName.Wiki: The part referenced by the event.

RegionName.Wiki: The region referenced by the event.

EntityID.Wiki: Identifies the event in event scripts.

SourceEventID.Wiki: The event ID the game uses for this event instead of Event ID. -1 uses Event ID. Events copied onto the distant-view tiles carry the original event's ID here.
